prompt:
Look at the table in the image. It shows a card-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, a rounded outer frame, and a shaded header row. Read the table and report the requested value or two-cell result. What is the sum of the values in the cells at row Eda, column Rank and row Hamo, column Cost?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] in the same order as the two queried cells.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact requested integer result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":29}
